GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. shared lead turn. weakened # Every Chance
Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the winning post was steadied between runners. Rider fined for failing to ride mount out to line

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. 3rd turn 2 lengths. got to outside in Straight . got to front 200 metres. just found enough # had the run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middles stages, Near the 1100m when racing keenly had to be steadied off heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 1 length. 2nd turn. weakened # Every Chance

Began well. Pushed fwd & worked to lead on rail by 1 length early . Held lead on inside midrace & joined in front @ 600m. Pushed to quicken on inside @ 450m & pressured =lead Two Wide on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & weakened in lat 200m. # Led & weakened.
Jumped Ok trapped 3 Wide early before settling 3rd 2 lengths. moved up 3 Wide turn 1 length. weakened # Wide early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced in the middle stages when its rider eased for cover. When questioned, rider advised that passing the 200m he felt that his mount may have been galloped on and after his mount had reacted and due to his concerns given his mount’s action, he did not test it for the remainder of the event. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to have only, some hair missing from its off hock.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. kicked well clear 300 metres. tired late # fell in
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden with cover – settled in the lead. Rider reported that although instructed to ride the horse with cover, his mount jumped well and was left racing in the lead when no other rider showed intent to take this position.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led turn giving good kick. weakened late # gave sight

Bumped @ start. Rolled fwd to lead on rail by 1 length early . Held lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Pushed along @ 300m & pressured & 2 Lengths clear @ 150m. Kept finding until fading late & grabbed near line. # Led - tried hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in slightly at the start and made contact with rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. 2nd turn getting off leaders back 2 lengths. battled on well # margin to 3rd
Jumped Ok sat handy 2 Lengths off, eased 3-4 Wide turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, found little and kept on one pace to the line # weak run home
Jumped Ok went to front. shared lead turn under pressure. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was reminded of his obligation to ride his mount’s out fully to the end of the race.
